flags: Split question: the evidence points to Rocking Chair being a SEPARATE campground: its 13 sites sit on the south-shore park road ~1.5 km east of Lazy Boy (2254), ~1.8 km across the water from North Shore and ~2 km from Howbert Point, with its own spur; CPW lists it as one of the park's nine campgrounds.
Eleven Mile's other campgrounds: see the flag on 2254 - every drive-in one has an entry; only the Backcountry Walk-In tent area (not drive-in) has none.
Pin 38.9299,-105.5272 is ~60 m from the site centroid; fine.
